## Summary

Describe the problem and the implemented solution.

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation

## Validation

- [ ] Backend checks/tests pass, when applicable.
- [ ] Frontend tests and production build pass, when applicable.
- [ ] Docker Compose configuration is valid, when applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, production data, or `.env` files are included.

## Deployment and rollback

Describe migrations, configuration changes, deployment steps, and the rollback procedure. Write `Not applicable` when none are required.

## Screenshots

Add screenshots for visible interface changes.
